title: Lead Response Odds by Speed
subtitle: Multiplier vs. baseline, published study values
description: Line chart showing how lead response odds fall as response time rises, using the published multipliers from the 2007 MIT/InsideSales.com Lead Response Management Study and the 2011 Harvard Business Review audit of 2,241 US firms. Responding within 5 minutes yields roughly 100x the odds of contacting a lead versus 30 minutes, 21x the odds of qualifying, and responding within 1 hour is about 7x more likely to qualify than responding later. Waiting 24 hours or longer drops odds toward a 1x baseline. Source: MIT & InsideSales.com (2007); HBR (2011).
